title: Appendix containing Canons and Rulings not having Conciliar Origin but Approved by Name in Canon II. of the Synod in Trullo: Of the Same to Diodorus Bishop of Tarsus, concerning a Man who had taken Two Sisters to Wife

verses.text:
Of the Same to Diodorus
Bishop of Tarsus, concerning a Man who had taken Two Sisters to
Wife.

(Found translated in lib. cit., p. 212
et seqq. Epistle clx.)

Contains the preface of his letter to Diodorus Bishop of
Tarsus, in which he tells him of a letter shewed him in justification
of a man’s marrying two sisters bearing his name; but he hopes it
was forged.

Contains the rest of the letter, in which he argues and
inveighs against this practice.
